title: Perfect complex and its categorical trace
statement:
Fix the global finite-field datum [def-weil-finite-field-fiber]. Use the finite-coefficient datum of [def-trf-coefficient-conventions]: a prime $\ell\neq p$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ contained in the fixed algebraic closure $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$, its valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$, a uniformizer $\varpi_E$, and an integer $n\geq1$. Put $A=A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$. Write $D(A)$ for the derived category of ordinary $A$-modules and $Q$ for the localization functor from cochain complexes [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let $\operatorname{Perf}(A)\subset D(A)$ be its full subcategory of perfect ring complexes [def-pc-perfect-ring-complex]: objects isomorphic to bounded complexes of finitely generated projective $A$-modules. The trace chapter's notation $D^b_{\mathrm{fin}}(A)$ in this definition means $\operatorname{Perf}(A)$, rather than the larger finite-cohomology category of [def-weil-point-finite-cohomology-complexes]. Bounded projective complexes are representatives, with morphisms taken modulo chain homotopy [lem-pc-ring-derived-map-representative], not the category with unquotiented chain maps.

Here is the explicit perfect-complex model for the defining maps. Choose a bounded projective representative $B^\bullet$ of $P\in\operatorname{Perf}(A)$. Put $B^\vee=\operatorname{Hom}_A^\bullet(B,A[0])$, the total module Hom complex [def-sc-module-total-hom-complex], so that $(B^\vee)^j=\operatorname{Hom}_A(B^{-j},A)$ and $(d^\vee\varphi)(x)=(-1)^{j+1}\varphi(dx)$. Write $P^\vee=R\operatorname{Hom}_A(P,A)$ for this derived dual; the bounded-above projective model is K-projective [lem-sc-bounded-above-projective-kprojective]. Tensor products on these representatives use the signed direct-sum total tensor of [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves], applied to ordinary modules (the category with one object and only its identity morphism, with only the maximal sieve covering, and constant coefficient ring $A$):
$$d(x\otimes y)=dx\otimes y+(-1)^{|x|}x\otimes dy,\qquad \operatorname{sym}(x\otimes y)=(-1)^{|x||y|}y\otimes x.$$
Their images in $D(A)$ compute $\otimes_A^L$, with unit $A[0]$: projective terms are flat [lem-weil-pbc-projective-module-flat], and bounded-above complexes of flat modules are K-flat [lem-pc-module-bounded-flat-kflat].

For each degree $i$ choose the ordinary-ring splitting package of [def-weil-pbc-strict-perfect-coefficient-package], $B^i\xrightarrow{\iota_i}A^{N_i}\xrightarrow{\pi_i}B^i$ with $\pi_i\iota_i=1$, taking $N_i=0$ whenever $B^i=0$. For the standard basis $u_a$ of $A^{N_i}$ put $e_{i,a}=\pi_i(u_a)$ and $\epsilon_{i,a}=\operatorname{pr}_a\iota_i$; thus $x=\sum_a\epsilon_{i,a}(x)e_{i,a}$. Use the evaluation and coevaluation given on this model by
$$\operatorname{ev}_B(\varphi\otimes x)=\varphi(x),\qquad \operatorname{coev}_B(1)=\sum_{i,a}e_{i,a}\otimes\epsilon_{i,a}.$$
Evaluation is zero on the summands of nonzero total degree. The sum is finite, and $\epsilon_{i,a}$ is placed in dual degree $-i$. Choose the representative isomorphism $\alpha:Q(B)\xrightarrow{\sim}P$. Its derived dual is $\alpha^\vee:P^\vee\xrightarrow{\sim}Q(B^\vee)$, induced by precomposition with $\alpha$. Under the strict-model identifications for derived tensor products, define
$$\operatorname{coev}_P=(\alpha\otimes_A^L(\alpha^\vee)^{-1})\circ Q(\operatorname{coev}_B):A[0]\longrightarrow P\otimes_A^LP^\vee,$$
$$\operatorname{ev}_P=Q(\operatorname{ev}_B)\circ(\alpha^\vee\otimes_A^L\alpha^{-1}):P^\vee\otimes_A^LP\longrightarrow A[0].$$
The chain-map assertions, triangle identities and independence of representatives are the subsequent assertions of lem-trf-chain-supertrace (a forward pointer, not a premise of the definition).

For an endomorphism $v:P\to P$ in $D(A)$ define its categorical trace to be
$$\operatorname{tr}_A(v\mid P):=\operatorname{ev}_P\circ\operatorname{sym}_{P,P^\vee}\circ(v\otimes_A^L1_{P^\vee})\circ\operatorname{coev}_P\in\operatorname{End}_{D(A)}(A[0])\cong A.$$
For the last identification, first apply the inverse of the Hom bijection for the fully faithful degree-zero embedding [lem-weil-pbc-derived-single-fully-faithful], obtaining an $A$-linear endomorphism of $A$, then evaluate it at $1$. Its inverse sends $a\in A$ to the derived image of multiplication by $a$ on $A[0]$.

blueprint_update.statement:
Fix the global finite-field datum
and the coefficient
conventions, with $A=A_{E,n}$, and define
$D^b_{\mathrm{fin}}(A)$ to be the category of *perfect*
$A$-complexes, realized explicitly as the category of bounded
complexes of finitely generated projective $A$-modules.
For $P\in D^b_{\mathrm{fin}}(A)$ put
$P^\vee=R\operatorname{Hom}_A(P,A)$. The coevaluation and evaluation
are

$$
\operatorname{coev}_P:A\longrightarrow P\otimes_A^LP^\vee,\qquad
\operatorname{ev}_P:P^\vee\otimes_A^LP\longrightarrow A,
$$

where $\otimes^L_A$ is the
derived tensor over $A$. For an
endomorphism $v:P\to P$, the *categorical trace* is

$$
\operatorname{tr}_A(v\mid P):=
\operatorname{ev}_P\circ\operatorname{sym}\circ
\bigl(v\otimes_A^L1\bigr)\circ\operatorname{coev}_P
\in\operatorname{End}_{D(A)}(A)\cong A.
$$

Here $\operatorname{End}_{D(A)}(A)\cong A$ sends an endomorphism of
$A$ to its degree-$0$ scalar.
